That left the schema half-migrated with no currency_code column, so every ingest-api write/query fails with 'Unknown column currency_code' (#149+), and ingest-gateway returns 500s. Requests were fine until right after #138.
You could also call this a bad schema-migration rollout started by ingest-api.
Red herring: a single schema-invalid message went to the DLQ well before onset, and event-processor stayed healthy.

verdict.recommendedAction: Fix the half-applied migration 0079: rename currency_code_old back to currency_code (or finish steps 2-3 manually during a quiet lock window), then check that ingest-api queries succeed. Stop migrate retries until then. Going forward, make migrations idempotent and reversible, and don't do non-transactional rename-then-add DDL on hot tables without a lock-timeout plan.
